name: Noise removal
description: Noise removal (D88, D246): FFT noise reduction on the track, starting from the noise floor measured in the track media's loudness analysis (a fixed floor per track, −40 dBFS when unmeasured). The export runs ffmpeg afftdn; the preview runs a spectral denoiser fitted to it, so it is heard while editing.
author: Biliup

amount.description: 0 = light (6 dB of reduction) … 1 = strong (30 dB).
